deployment.scope: isolated local production containers; self-signed test TLS; separate local journal storage
checks: non-root production API and TLS Nginx startup
TLS login, Secure cookie, static SPA/SDK, forwarded-header overwrite
runtime role cannot DDL, alter migration history or create admins; no decrypt key
encrypted pg_dump + matching key backup + inventory
real HTTPS journal acknowledgements and completion records; site and visitor deletion

actual pg_restore of pre-deletion snapshot, replay of every intent, privacy gaps, production API boots against restored DB
post-restore maintenance reuses immutable completion sequences and retains privacy gaps
